description: The plot illustrates the relationship between "Initial Confidence" and "Accuracy." The x-axis represents "Initial Confidence" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.91 to 0.98 with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.01. The y-axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines, all of which include vertical error bars at each data point. A solid blue line with circular markers begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.85 at an initial confidence of 0.91, rises to a peak of 1.0 at 0.92, and remains relatively steady across the rest of the axis, ending at 1.0 at 0.98. A dashed orange line with diamond markers starts at approximately 0.64 at 0.91, reaches a peak of approximately 0.93 at 0.92, and then exhibits a steady decline, ending at approximately 0.09 at 0.98. A dash-dot green line with square markers begins at approximately 0.21 at 0.91, dips to a low of approximately 0.08 at 0.92, and then demonstrates a steady rise, concluding at approximately 0.91 at 0.98.
